newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth denied Ga. long distance - report.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth denied Ga. long distance - report.

text.p: BellSouth Corp's bid to enter the long-distance telephone business in Georgia has been rejected by state regulators, a newspaper reported on Friday.

The Atlanta Journal-Constitution said the Georgia Public Service Commission voted 5-0 against the regional Bell holding company this week after concluding that its plans did not meet requirements set down in the Telecommunications Act of 1996.
Officials at neither BellSouth nor the state commission were immediately available to comment.
